turns.prompt: Make a local playable image-notes page using the painting as the actual featured image and the schematic only as an overlay-relationship reference. The original painting must remain proportionate and recognizable. Show two approaches A and B for a local detail panel opened from a labeled point near the image boundary. The panel should belong to that trigger rather than look like a page-wide notification. Keep the painting as the main focus, with the trigger and detail panel secondary. Pointer and keyboard activation must work; the panel needs a close control and an Escape path that returns focus to its trigger. On a narrow screen, preserve the relationship without hiding the image behind a permanent full-screen box. Show actual intermediate opening/closing states. Deliver index.html, desktop.png, mobile.png, sequence-early.png, sequence-middle.png, sequence-late.png, evidence.json, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. The desktop and three sequence images are 1280x800; the mobile image is 390x844. Use actual browser captures. In evidence.json record the input actions and observed intermediate states; keep unexecuted behaviors explicitly untested.

Choose B for its panel-to-trigger relation, not the extra shadow. Keep A unchanged. Lighten only B's shadow and border weight so the detail remains readable but stops competing with the painting. Keep the image proportions, trigger position, panel ownership, and close behavior. Make the narrow layout keep the trigger visible while the panel is open. Deliver index.html, desktop.png, mobile.png, sequence-early.png, sequence-middle.png, sequence-late.png, evidence.json, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. The desktop and three sequence images are 1280x800; the mobile image is 390x844. Use actual browser captures. In evidence.json record the input actions and observed intermediate states; keep unexecuted behaviors explicitly untested.

When I close the panel while scrolling, keep my scroll position and restore focus to the same trigger without reopening it. If I immediately reopen, begin from the current visual state without a flash of the old fully open panel. Preserve the accepted border/shadow and narrow layout. With reduced motion, keep the same focus and content ownership while removing travel. Deliver index.html, desktop.png, mobile.png, sequence-early.png, sequence-middle.png, sequence-late.png, evidence.json, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. The desktop and three sequence images are 1280x800; the mobile image is 390x844. Use actual browser captures. In evidence.json record the input actions and observed intermediate states; keep unexecuted behaviors explicitly untested.
